purpose: Tier-1 honest uncertainty bounds on the 17.3% full-stack judged residual, derived from the judge's two measured error modes on the 46-record defended calibration sample. NO new model calls; recomputed from on-disk artifacts only.

anchor.note: Headline figure of record. Treated as FIXED for this correction; its own sampling CI is not re-opened. UNCHANGED by this task.

calibration_sample.design: Stratified, ENRICHED for judge-positives: ALL 18 judge-flagged pool responses included; judge-negative strata subsampled. NOT a proportional random sample.

over_flag_false_positive.note: PPV/FDR denominator (18) is a CENSUS of all judge-positives in the 143-response pool -> exact for the pool. FPR denominator (36 human-negatives) is NOT a census.

miss_false_negative.note: Only 3 missed-leak data points -> all per-mode rates are LOW PRECISION.

method.name: Test-result-stratified prevalence decomposition
method.why_not_rogan_gladen: Rogan-Gladen (q+spec-1)/(sens+spec-1) = -0.336 is DEGENERATE/negative here: sample specificity (25/36=0.694) is biased low because the enriched design captured ALL false positives but only a fraction of true negatives, so sample FPR (0.306) exceeds the apparent rate (0.173). Sensitivity/specificity do NOT transfer from a sample stratified on the judge's output; PPV and FOR do.

corrected_estimate.interpretation: Over-flag and missed-leak corrections nearly cancel. The 1.7pp recentering is 0.33 binomial SE -> NOT resolvable in direction. The ~5-26% band CONTAINS 17.3%. The data CANNOT place the residual below 17.3%.

naive_overflag_only_floor.WARNING: Over-flag correction ALONE; IGNORES missed leaks among the large judge-negative mass. NOT a valid population estimate; must NOT be cited as 'true leakage'. Restoring the missed-leak term lifts it back to ~15.6%.

sensitivity_stratum_weighted_FOR.rationale: All 3 misses fall in the redacted_residue stratum, which was under-sampled relative to clean_refusal (census). Pooled FOR=3/28 under-weights the only stratum containing misses.
sensitivity_stratum_weighted_FOR.note: Accounting for non-proportional sampling nudges the point CLOSER to 17.3% (15.6% -> 16.5%), reinforcing that the data cannot place the residual below 17.3%. No separate tight CI is claimed for this variant.

hard_caveats: n=46; only 18 judge-positives, 10 human-leaks, 3 missed leaks -> per-mode rates are LOW PRECISION and the interval is WIDE, not tight.
Normal-approx 95% band; with 3 events the normal approximation is rough -> exact/Wilson would be wider and asymmetric. Treat [5.3%,25.8%] as 'at least this wide'.
Sample is stratified and ENRICHED for judge-positives -> do NOT claim 'true leakage < 17.3%'. The point sits within 0.33 SE of 17.3% and the band contains it.
Calibration pools C01100+C11111; q is C11111-only. Cross-config transfer of PPV/FOR is assumed.
q held FIXED (headline of record); only judge-vs-human calibration uncertainty is propagated.
HONEST BOUNDING, not a new precise estimate. The 17.3% headline is UNCHANGED and remains the figure of record.
